verification.notes: Verified as an attribution/citation claim, not as proof of an objective psychological rule. The source-scoped transcript shows Candace Owens introducing the passage as an expert quotation and naming Alan Wolfelt. A current web copy of the reported Daily Mail article reproduces Wolfelt's statement that the reaction reflects a mourning-avoidant, emotion-phobic culture in which people make quick, uninformed judgments about how others are supposed to grieve. The episode transcript independently reproduces the same wording and attribution. Medium confidence because the original Daily Mail page was inaccessible to the research tool, although the copied article and episode transcript agree.
